source_quote: The observed T1/2 of CT105 was 2.7 h, 1.72-fold longer than the 1.57 h half-life reported for T20.21
route_quote: rats were administered a single dose of CT105 (6 mg/kg in phosphate buffer) intravenously via the tail vein.
notes: CT105 value measured here; the T20 1.57 h value in the same sentence is cited from ref 21 (not relevant to this record).
